signals.description: Horizontal iris centre offset from the eye-corner midpoint, divided by the inter-corner distance. Normalising by the eye's own width is what makes this comparable across participants and across distances: the same gaze produces the same ratio whether the face fills the frame or not.

Vertical iris offset, also in eye-widths. Tiered LOWER than the horizontal channel on purpose: the vertical range of eye movement is a fraction of the horizontal one and is partly occluded by the eyelid, so the same pixel noise is a much larger share of the signal. §4.2's AOI padding argument applies asymmetrically for the same reason.
Eyelid aperture over eye width. Gates the iris channels rather than describing gaze: a blink makes an iris estimate meaningless rather than merely noisy.

Distance between the two iris centres in pixels. A scale proxy: it shrinks as the participant leans back, which is how the estimator can notice that the geometry recovered by the virtual chinrest no longer holds mid-session.

Emitted here as well as by the facial engine because gaze in screen coordinates is a function of head orientation AND eye-in-head angle. An estimator given only the iris cannot tell a head turn from an eye movement.

events.description: Face detection dropped below presence confidence
Both eyes below the openness threshold; iris features are not meaningful across this span

quality.description: Measured per session, never assumed. §5.3 uses 5 Hz as a published exclusion threshold, which removed 18 of 220 participants in one study.
Fraction of frames with a face above presence confidence.

Fraction of frames yielding usable iris features. Distinct from face_detect_rate: a face can be tracked confidently while the eyes are closed, off-frame or too small to localise an iris in, and only this figure says whether gaze was measurable.
§2.5: the rPPG skin-tone accuracy gap largely closes at luminance >=30. Carried here too because it is the evidence base's only quantified bias mitigation and applies to any camera-based measurement.

license.notes: Apache-2.0 covers the library. The .task model bundle's own licence line was NOT verified during research — re-verify before any commercial ship. Flagged rather than assumed. NOTE: this engine emits FEATURES only, never a gaze direction, so it inherits no gaze-dataset EULA. The estimator fitted on top of these features is where training-set provenance starts to matter.
